overview.commentary: The portfolio returned 59.44% annualised against 25.57% volatility (Sharpe 1.78) — excellent risk-adjusted performance at a elevated risk level. HPE carries the largest weight at 2.9%; SNDK dominates risk contribution at 8.1%. On a typical bad day expect losses near 2.79% (95% VaR), with the worst 5% averaging 3.62% (CVaR) and peak-to-trough drawdown over the period of -11.97%. Action: profile looks balanced; monitor correlation drift around the next earnings cycle.

risk.commentary: Monte Carlo (10k paths, 1Y horizon): 95% VaR 9.91%, 99% VaR 22.53%, CVaR 95% 17.72%. Probability of >20% loss: 1.50%. Worst historical replay is GFC_peak_to_trough (-57.57% return, max drawdown -58.46%, worst day -13.36%). GARCH(1,1) 30-day forecast vol is 23.71% vs realised 21.86% — vol regime rising. Persistence alarm: ARE, INTC, EG, MU, SNDK, TWLO, LITE, WDC, STX, TSN, GPN, LEN, FISV have α+β > 0.95, meaning shocks decay slowly — drawdowns there will compound longer than a Gaussian model would imply.
